subject: Cascadia Energy — invoice channel selection & banking details
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Tran <alyssa.tran@cascadia.energy>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cascadia onboarding — banking and invoice routing (kickoff)

Hi Alyssa —

Great to meet you last week. We're ready to kick off vendor setup for Cascadia so finance can start routing POs and payments cleanly. To get us moving, can you confirm the following items from your side and return any supporting docs you have?

1) Preferred payment rails: ACH (domestic) or wire international? If you prefer wire, please indicate whether you can accept USD or need payments in EUR/GBP.
2) Remittance contact / email address for invoice confirmation (where AP sends remittance notices).
3) Invoice submission method: email to AP, vendor portal, EDI/Coupa, or other?
4) Standard payment terms (Net30/Net45/etc.) and whether PO number is required on the invoice.
5) Bank confirmation letter or voided check for ACH (if available).

I'm attaching our vendor onboarding form and a copy of our W-9 for your records — please complete the form and return it along with bank confirmation. Once we have that, finance will provision Cascadia as a payee and confirm PO/terms.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (form), Redwood_W9_2027.pdf (tax)

Thanks — quick responses on 1–3 will speed this up.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0188

From: Alyssa Tran <alyssa.tran@cascadia.energy>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@cascadia.energy>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Cascadia onboarding — banking and invoice routing (kickoff)

Hi Sean —

Thanks — happy to provide. Quick clarifications before we send documents:

- We prefer ACH for domestic USD. For international payments, we accept wire in USD only.
- Remittance email: ap@cascadia.energy (this is monitored by our AP team).
- Invoice submission: our preferred flow is emailed invoices to ap@cascadia.energy, but we can accept uploads to your vendor portal if Redwood supports PDF uploads. We do not currently use EDI/Coupa for vendor invoices.
- Payment terms: Net30 standard for our vendors. PO numbers are required on all invoices.

We'll return the filled onboarding form plus a bank confirmation PDF in the next message. One question — do you need a specific invoice header for your accounting system (company name vs DBA)?

Thanks,
Alyssa Tran
Vendor Relations Lead
Cascadia Energy
alyssa.tran@cascadia.energy
(206) 222-6705

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Tran <alyssa.tran@cascadia.energy>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 14:22:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Cascadia onboarding — banking and invoice routing (kickoff)

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the quick answers — super helpful. A couple of operational notes from finance:

- Invoice header: please use the legal name "Cascadia Energy, Inc." and include your remit-to address in the body of the invoice.
- PO handling: our AP system will match on PO number + invoice total. If a PO number is missing, invoices will be routed back to the submitter which delays payment.
- Portal uploads: yes, we have a vendor invoice portal (link below) and we can accept PDFs there. If you prefer email, please use ap-invoices@redwood.ai and include the PO number in the subject line (PO# 12345).

I have attached an editable copy of the vendor onboarding form and our W-9 for your completion. Once we receive the completed form and a bank confirmation, finance will create the payee record and issue a confirmation email with the assigned vendor ID.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf, Redwood_W9_2027.pdf

Portal: https://redwood-invoice-portal.example.com/portal/submit

If you want, we can schedule a brief 15-min call tomorrow to walk through the form.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Finance Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@cascadia.energy>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Tran <alyssa.tran@cascadia.energy>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:45:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Cascadia onboarding — banking and invoice routing (kickoff)

Thanks Monica — attached is our bank confirmation and the completed onboarding form. A couple of notes from our Treasury team:

- We attached cascadia_bank_confirmation.pdf (bank letter) for ACH setup.
- We can accept ACH in USD only; if Redwood needs to wire, provide wire instructions and we will confirm any intermediary bank fees — we prefer to avoid wires if possible.
- Our remittance email is ap@cascadia.energy — please confirm your remittance to us will be an emailed remittance advice to that address.

We have also noted PO requirement and will include PO numbers on all invoices going forward.

Thanks,
Jordan Lee
Senior Treasury Analyst
Cascadia Energy
jordan.lee@cascadia.energy

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@cascadia.energy>, Alyssa Tran <alyssa.tran@cascadia.energy>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 12:10:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Cascadia onboarding — banking and invoice routing (kickoff)

Hi Jordan / Alyssa —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the bank confirmation. Confirming the finance side action items:

- Redwood will set up Cascadia as a vendor using the provided bank confirmation.
- Preferred payment method: ACH (USD). For any wires, AP will reach out for explicit approval and will provide wire instructions if needed.
- Payment terms: Net30. Expected cycle: invoices received and validated by the 1st business day of the month are paid on the next cycle (standard net30 cadence).
- Remittance advice: Redwood will send remittance emails to ap@cascadia.energy after payment posts; subject will include the Redwood vendor ID and invoice numbers.
- Invoice submission: both ap-invoices@redwood.ai (email) and the vendor portal are acceptable. Use ap-invoices@redwood.ai if you prefer no-login email. Portal upload link: https://redwood-invoice-portal.example.com/portal/submit

Next steps for you: please confirm the invoice header reads "Cascadia Energy, Inc.", and continue to include PO# on each invoice. We'll confirm by email once the vendor ID is active (should be within 48 business hours).

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
